# PeriodicQuantumDot

Module: **QuantumDots** · directory: `QuantumDots/src/Programs` · binary: `QuantumDots/src/Programs/PeriodicQuantumDot`

```text
usage : 

  -l, --lanczos : enable lanczos diagonalization algorithm
  -h, --help : display this help
  -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
  -v, --verbose : verbose mode
  -i, --iter-max : maximum number of lanczos iteration (default value = 3000)
  -n, --nbr-eigen : number of eigenvalues (default value = 6)
  -e, --eigenstate : evaluate eigenstates
  -M, --M-cell : number of cells in the x direction (default value = 61)
  -N, --N-cell : number of cells in the y direction (default value = 61)
  -H, --H-cell : number of cells in the z direction (default value = 60)
  -X, --cell-xsize : cell size in the x direction in Angstrom (default value = 2.9700000000000002)
  -Y, --cell-ysize : cell size in the y direction in Angstrom (default value = 2.9700000000000002)
  -Z, --cell-zsize : cell size in the z direction in Angstrom (default value = 2.6400000000000001)
  --mu-x : electron effective mass in x direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.50449999999999995)
  --mu-y : electron effective mass in y direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.50449999999999995)
  --mu-z : electron effective mass in z direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 1.1000000000000001)
  --coefficients : name of the file where interaction coeffcients are stored
  --left-size : size of the leftmost part in the z direction with constant null potential (in cell unit) (default value = 18)
  --right-size : size of the rightmost part in the z direction with constant potential (in cell unit) (default value = 26)
  -c, --carrier : carrier type, true for hole, false for electron
```
